title: Looking cannot tell
note: Ali Qushji on why no observation settles whether the earth turns, and what he wanted that to free astronomy from.

key: A star, where you see it

beats.text: You cannot see whether Earth spins
Ali Qushji said so in the 1400s
beats.sub: an astronomer in Samarkand, then Istanbul

beats.call: Watch one star cross the sky
beats.callsub: it rises, arcs over, and it sets

beats.call: If the sky turns around us

beats.callsub: you would see exactly this too

beats.sub: so watching the sky cannot settle it

beats.text: He did not say Earth moves
beats.sub: he said nobody had proved it does not

beats.text: Go by what you can measure
